title: Canonical finite integral reduction transitions retain their finite scalar law
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, a scheme Y, and the completed and finite coefficient sheaves and canonical strict reduction tower [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Let A_n be the constant coefficient quotient of exponent n+1 and q_n:A_(n+1) -> A_n its quotient map. For any complex P of completed-coefficient modules, degree i, site object U, scalar s in A_(n+1)(U), and section x of the higher reduction of P in degree i, the recorded transition satisfies t_n(s x)=q_n(s)t_n(x), with scalar actions before restriction to completed coefficients [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars; def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

source.place: Tag 03EK, change of rings and its restriction-of-scalars construction; the quotient-transition construction in def-weil-integral-reduction-tower.

proof.text: The termwise finite transition is restriction of an actual map of sheaves of modules from the higher finite coefficient ring to the lower finite coefficient ring. In the chosen reduction-functor presentation it is conjugated by the specified equalities identifying the objects with their scalar-extension constructions. These identifications are linear over their respective finite coefficient rings, so the conjugated transition satisfies t(s x)=q(s)t(x).

Assemble these degreewise maps into the explicit natural transformation of complexes. The existing unique pure-tensor characterization of the recorded reduction transition identifies this transformation with that transition. Transport the scalar equation across this equality. This works for all levels including n=0, all complexes including zero, and scalars zero and one; there is no flatness hypothesis.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03EK, applied to the explicit scalar-extension map. Assemble the termwise map and identify it with the canonical transition by its unique generator characterization.

lean.statement:
theorem unrestrictedIntegralTransition_smul (n : ℕ)
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ) (i : ℤ)
    (U : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ) (s : (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y (n + 1)).obj.obj U)
    (x : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y (n + 1)).obj P).X i).val.obj U) :
    (((unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E Y n).app P).f i).val.app U (s • x) =
      (integralCoefficientSheafTransition l E Y n).hom.app U s •
        (show (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P).X i).val.obj U from
          (((unrestrictedIntegralTransition l E Y n).app P).f i).val.app U x)
